description: scheduler.ts drops interim captions at median RTF > 0.8 and pauses live STT at > 1.5, where RTF = decode time / utterance length (live-provider.ts). Autoregressive decode has fixed overhead, so short utterances ('yeah') report RTF near or above 1 and push the level up, making captions final-only or paused. Use compute per second of NEW audio over a rolling window, ignore utterances under ~1 s, and degrade on real backlog (sttBacklogS) rather than per-call RTF. Tests for short-utterance streams not escalating.

comments.text: Landed (jj rev 'Scheduler judges STT load per second of new audio'). SchedulerSample now carries sttComputeMs/sttNewAudioS deltas; scheduler keeps a ~10 s-of-audio window (judged after 4 s) and degrades at load > 1 (interims) / > 1.5 (live STT) or backlog > 4 / 20 s. Streaming backlog excludes catch-up audio. Unit test covers short/expensive calls not escalating and sustained overload escalating. Simulator two_cities: before (kdl.9) Small hit level 1 on one 0.99 pass; now level 0 throughout. Small interim lag p50/p95 0.32/0.62 s, final 0.68/0.97 s, compute 0.65; Tiny interim 0.11/0.20 s, final 0.21/0.43 s, compute 0.20, load 645 ms. Live tests 5/5.
